subject: pharmacology
title: Antivirals: herpes, hepatitis, influenza and COVID

steps.tx: **Aciclovir** (viral thymidine kinase activated, HSV and VZV, **crystal nephropathy** with hydration, neurotoxicity in renal failure) with **valaciclovir** (prodrug bioavailability, zoster and suppression) and famciclovir treats; **resistance** (thymidine kinase mutants in immunocompromise) switches to **foscarnet**. Encephalitis IV high dose with fluids saves; neonatal and ocular emergencies dose aggressively. TTP and HUS with high dose immunocompromise watched.
steps.say: HSV VZV encephalitis gets IV aciclovir hydrated: crystals clog dry kidneys. Resistant immunocompromise foscarnet.

steps.tx: **Ganciclovir and valganciclovir** (CMV retinitis, colitis, transplant prophylaxis; **neutropenia** with G-CSF backup, teratogenic) suppress while **foscarnet** (resistant CMV and HSV, **electrolyte chaos**: hypo and hypercalcaemia, hypo and hyperphosphataemia, hypomagnesaemia with seizures, **hydration mandatory**, penile ulcers) rescues; **cidofovir** (nephrotoxic with **probenecid** and saline, uveitis) thirds. Electrolytes with creatinine gate foscarnet courses.
steps.say: CMV marrow suppresses on ganciclovir; resistant electrolytes chaos on foscarnet hydrated. Counts and chemistry gate.

steps.tx: **Oseltamivir** (high risk flu 48 hours, prophylaxis outbreaks, nausea) with **baloxavir** (single dose cap dependent, resistance PA) and **zanamivir** (bronchospasm) treats influenza; **ribavirin** (RSV aerosol legacy, HCV with interferon past, **teratogenic** with haemolytic anaemia) is now niche. Amantadine (Parkinson, adamantane resistance ubiquitous) retired flu. Vaccines prevent best; steroids debate severe.
steps.say: High risk flu 48 hours gets oseltamivir; single dose baloxavir caps. Ribavirin teratogenic anaemias limit.

steps.tx: **HCV DAAs** (**sofosbuvir with velpatasvir** pangenotypic 12 weeks, **amiodarone bradycardia** lethal combo, **HBV reactivation** screened) cure; **HBV** (tenofovir, entecavir per hepatitis wave) suppresses. **Remdesivir** (early COVID outpatient and hypoxic inpatient, transaminases watched) with **nirmatrelvir-ritonavir** (**Paxlovid**: **CYP3A4 interactions** pausing statins and anticoagulants, dysgeusia, **rebound**, renal dosed) treats COVID by risk; molnupiravir (mutagenic, pregnancy banned) lasts. Monoclonals variant chase.
steps.say: Amiodarone plus sofosbuvir stops hearts: screen. Paxlovid pauses CYP3A4 victims; rebound counsels.
